result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: the bottom navigation bar overlaps the content, hiding part of the last restaurant card and making it harder to interact with.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card is partially covered by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so its image/content is cut off and not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content, or adjust the fixed navigation so it does not overlap the last visible card.
